description: Hardware identity of the AEFI device: source geometry, excitation electronics, sensor, conditioning electronics

sphere_labels._note: Quadrant convention (2026-07-24, corrects the earlier x+/x-/y+/y- half-axis labeling). S_i occupies a quadrant, not a half-axis. Source of truth: 'ImagerieElectrique - Correspondance Poupette Sortie DDS - Connexion Carte Amplification Excitation' and NOTE - Source Frame Geometry.md.

pairwise_distances._note: 6 center-to-center distances (m), derived from caliper measurements taken 2026-07-24 (see mesures-dgp-pied-a-coulisse-4spheres). Caliper reads the total span between the outer extremities of the two spheres (D_ij), so center-to-center = D_ij - r_i - r_j. uncertainty.expanded = U = k*u_c (GUM), combining the D_ij and two radius readings in quadrature at the instrument resolution (0.02mm vernier, u = res/(2*sqrt(3)) per reading).

r_sphere._note: Per-sphere radius (m). Replaces the single scalar r_sphere: the 2026-07-24 measurement changed method to measure phi_i per sphere instead of assuming an identical diameter for all four (see mesures-dgp-pied-a-coulisse-4spheres, changelog entry). uncertainty.expanded from a single diameter reading at 0.02mm vernier resolution, halved for the radius.

dimension.description: Characteristic size of the sensor cube

z_offset.description: Z distance from the source plane to the center of the sensor
